description: Zigzags across the ENTIRE soundfile while playing it (submode 2 - the marklist-free member of the segszig trio): the read head sweeps forward and backward repets times, so the output is the source plaited with its own retrogrades. Duration = indur * 2 * repets * prop, verified to -1.3% worst case (15.8949 from 2 s at repets 4; 31.7748 at 8; 7.9550 at 2; 7.8949 from 1 s at 4; flat noise identical duration; prop 0.2 -> 3.0949 vs 3.2 predicted). shrinkto (-s, ms floor) makes successive zigs contract toward a minimum size - the output then SHORTENS below the model (17.53 vs 31.77 at repets 8/-s100) as later zigzags tighten into a stutter-vortex. Mode 1 zigzags only across marked tail segments (needs a marklist); mode 3's extra 'dur' positional was found INERT (byte-identical to mode 2 at the same repets, dur 5 ignored). Deterministic. MONO only.
musical_use: The one-knob palindrome machine: repets 2-4 turns a phrase into a hypnotic forward-backward weave (every reversal is a seamless zero-glide, no clicks); higher counts read as scrubbing/DJ-drag. Add shrinkto to make the zigzags contract - the gesture accelerates into a churning vortex before releasing, a ready-made transition or riser-in-reverse. prop < 1 zigzags over only the first part of each pass (shorter, denser output). Deterministic, so renders are dependable building blocks; for randomised scrubbing use modify drunk instead.

repets.description: Number of zigzag traversals; output grows ~linearly (x2 per repet). BANNER DIVERGENCE: the usage calls it '(timevariable)' but a breakpoint file is refused - 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 1 [rp.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' Scalar only.

shrinkto.description: If nonzero, zigzags contract toward this minimum size in ms (banner: 'Range 31 upwards'; 0 = no effect). Shortens the output below the duration model (17.53 s vs 31.77 predicted at repets 8, -s100) - excluded from the model.

prop.description: Proportion of the material to zigzag over (default all). Scales the output (~-3.3% model error at 0.2). Banner marks it '(timevariable)' but a breakpoint file is refused ('Cannot read parameter 4 ... brkpnt_files not permitted.') - scalar only.

log_shrink.description: Shrink zigzags logarithmically instead of linearly (meaningful with shrinkto > 0). Pass 1 to enable.

examples.expected_use: A 2 s source becomes ~15.9 s of seamless forward/backward plaiting (indur * 2 * 4).
Zigzags tighten toward 100 ms with a log curve - the gesture accelerates into a churn; output well below the nominal 32 s.

known_issues: BANNER DIVERGENCE: repets and prop are labelled '(timevariable)' but both refuse breakpoint files (verbatim refusals recorded) - no time-variable parameter exists in this mode.
Mode 3's 'dur' positional is INERT on this build: 'segszig 3 in out 4 5.0' rendered byte-identical to 'segszig 2 in out 4' (15.8949 s, same sha) - the advertised duration-targeting does not function.
shrinkto > 0 pulls the output below the duration model (documented, excluded); prop scales it (included).
Stereo refused: 'ERROR: File st2.wav is not of correct type (must be mono)'. Flat noise duration matches the tone render exactly (content-independent model).
